name: Hindi chat spellings (hand-written)
verdict_reason: Written by hand for this repository, so there is no third-party licence to follow or credit; the app credits third-party sources only.
attribution: A short table of irregular Hinglish chat spellings (kyu for क्यों, yeh for यह, hum for हम), written for this keyboard. No third-party data.
used_for: The Hindi pack's chatForms file (packs/hi.neopack/chat-forms.tsv): a typed or swiped chat spelling offers its Hindi word (engine/core/src/chat_forms.rs).
